name: Vancine Seedance Video
description: Submit one Seedance text-to-video task to Vancine, poll its status with a bounded wait loop and return the completed video URL.
requirements: Vancine API key stored as a secret Variable or n8n Header Auth credential
Currently supported Vancine Seedance model ID, prompt and output size
Execution runtime configured to retain waits across the full polling period
